then.text: As now you and \v[77] are travelling together, I thought it was a good time to give you some tips on personal relationships.

else.text: As now you and \v[76] are travelling together, I thought it was a good time to give you some tips on personal relationships.

list.text: When you talk with your partner you can see an option called "Trainer Card"
There you can see how your relationship with your travel buddy is going.
The hearts in the bottom section show how are you progressing, when it reaches 10 your relationship level's up!
The higher your partner's level, the stronger their Pokémon become and the more options are unlocked!
And at the right-top corner you can observe your partner's mood; they can be super sad, sad, calm, happy, and in love.

then.text: You should talk with him often too, I'm sure you have lot's of common things to talk about!

else.text: You should talk with her often too, I'm sure you have lot's of common things to talk about!

list.text: As you grow you'll notice that life is not just about Pokémon, bur personal relationships as well!
Did you understand everything?

branches.text: For now, I think that's all...\nGood luck on your journey here in Hoenn!
